errors.evidence: The description states the x-axis is linear, but the spacing between the tick marks is not proportional to the values they represent, indicating a custom or non-linear scale. For example, the distance on the axis between 0.2 and 0.5 is shorter than the distance between 0.02 and 0.05.
The y-axis has tick labels at intervals of 0.025 (e.g., 0.000, 0.025, 0.050, etc.), not 0.05.
The AU line (red) is flat at approximately 0.125 between perturbation strengths 0.02 and 0.1; it does not decrease. The value at 0.05 is the same as the starting value, not 0.12.
